description: This file defines the GroupRepository interface, which extends JPA repository interfaces to manage persistence operations for the Group entity in the project. It includes a custom query method to retrieve the 'submittedOnDate' for a specific group by its ID.

classes.name: GroupRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Group entities, providing CRUD operations and custom queries.

methods.name: findByParentId
methods.description: Finds all Group entities with a specific parent ID.

methods.name: retrieveGroupTypeSubmitteOndDate
methods.description: Executes a custom JPQL query to retrieve the 'submittedOnDate' of a Group identified by its ID.
